Russian

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From уво́лить (uvólitʹ) +‎ -я́ть (-játʹ), with unexpected interpolation of -н- influenced by во́льный (vólʹnyj, “free”).

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): [ʊvɐlʲˈnʲætʲ]
  • Audio:(file)

Verb

[edit]

увольня́ть • (uvolʹnjátʹ) impf (perfective уво́лить)

  1. to discharge, to dismiss, to fire, to sack
